Shared Shade.name: Shared Shade
Shared Shade.description: The user holds a person close, or a bundle no bigger than a person, and bends the light around both of them. While the user keeps hold and moves no faster than a walk, the held person and everything they wear are invisible too, so a hostage can be walked out past guards; it ends if the user lets go, takes a hard hit or the scene ends. Strain: heavy.
